title: Invited teammates land on empty state and can only create a team, not join inviter's team
description:
Reported by user mariabaseleon@gmail.com: created team 'MedLocations', invited people; when invitees click the email link they can only create a new team instead of seeing MedLocations and entering their Wordle board.

Invite/join path (v1 app, dev branch):
- invitePlayer (src/app/me/actions.ts): for new email -> supabase.auth.admin.inviteUserByEmail(email,{data:{invited:true}}) + appends email to teams.invited[].
- Invitee clicks link -> /api/auth/callback -> finishSignIn (src/lib/utils.ts) -> handleInvite gates on user.user_metadata.invited===true -> rpc handle_invited_signup(invited_email,invited_id).
- handle_invited_signup (migration 20240517174331) appends invited_id to player_ids for teams WHERE invited_email = ANY(invited), removes from invited, sets user_metadata.invited=false.

Leading hypotheses (need DB/Sentry evidence to confirm):
- B: invitee authenticated via OAuth (Google) instead of clicking the emailed invite link, so the account they use lacks invited:true metadata -> handleInvite never runs.
- E: email case/whitespace mismatch between teams.invited[] entry and auth user email -> WHERE invited_email = ANY(invited) matches nothing.
- A: invitee already had an account -> inviteUserByEmail path differs.

Next: read-only prod query of teams.invited/player_ids for MedLocations + auth.users metadata/providers for invitees; check Sentry for handle_invited_signup errors.
design:
Proposed fix (route invite through the callback via token_hash path the app already supports):
1. Pass redirectTo to both inviteUserByEmail calls: `/api/auth/callback?next=/me`.
2. Update Supabase INVITE email template (prod dashboard) to: {{ .SiteURL }}/api/auth/callback?token_hash={{ .TokenHash }}&type=invite&next=/me  (uses handleEmailSignin/verifyOtp token_hash path; no PKCE code_verifier needed).
3. Ensure prod Site URL + additional_redirect_urls include app domain and /api/auth/callback.
Regression test: e2e - invitePlayer -> GET callback token_hash&type=invite -> assert redirect /me, player_ids contains invitee, invited[] cleared, user_metadata.invited=false; unit - assert inviteUserByEmail called with redirectTo.
Data remediation (after fix): resend invite to jonathan (unconfirmed user) or manually attach; ask Maria which other emails she invited (only 1 recorded).
acceptance_criteria: Root cause confirmed with prod evidence; invitees who click invite link land on inviter's team and can enter their board; regression test added.
notes:
ROOT CAUSE CONFIRMED via prod (dcfqzbdusxhrfgvnpwqc) read-only diagnostics 2026-07-28.

Evidence:
- Team 206 'MedLocations': player_ids=[Maria only]; invited=['jonathan.m.esparza@gmail.com'] (still pending). Only 1 invite ever recorded despite 'people'.
- auth.users jonathan.m.esparza@gmail.com: user_metadata.invited=true, provider=email, last_sign_in_at=NULL, email_confirmed_at=NULL -> he has NEVER completed authentication. So join RPC (handle_invited_signup) is NOT the problem; it never runs.
- Maria authenticated via google (works). Only confirmed-working auth path in prod is Google OAuth (browser PKCE w/ code_verifier cookie).

Mechanism: invitePlayer calls supabase.auth.admin.inviteUserByEmail(email,{data:{invited:true}}) with NO redirectTo (actions.ts:120,145). Invite link therefore redirects to project Site URL, not /api/auth/callback. Clients use @supabase/ssr default PKCE (no flowType). Invitee lands unauthenticated (default template code-exchange needs a code_verifier cookie that admin-initiated invites don't have) -> never routed through handleInvite -> no team join. Login OTP works only because it uses code-entry/verifyOtp, not the email link; invite has only the email link.
